# Fluoddity3D reference notice

The DVE Fluoddity module is a clean native C++ reimplementation of the simulation and preset contracts in Fluoddity3D by Jesse Gelders. Fluoddity3D is licensed under the MIT License; the original license is preserved in this directory.

The test fixture `tests/assets/fluoddity_v7_av0.json` is copied from the Fluoddity3D version-7 preset library and is covered by that license. DVE does not embed the original Python application, ModernGL/GLFW/ImGui shell, CUDA code, or OptiX renderer.
